# 應該 + Verb · *jing1 goi1 + Verb*

**Meaning:** should; ought to; probably · **Level:** A2 · **Topic:** Wants, needs and ability

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fjing1-goi1-should).

應該 gives advice ('you should') or a reasonable guess ('she should be there by now').

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你應該早啲瞓。** |
| Jyutping | nei5 jing1 goi1 zou2 di1 fan3. |
| Yale | néih yīng gōi jóu dī fan. |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄧㄥ¹ ㄍㄛㄧ¹ ㄗㄛㄨ² ㄉㄧ¹ ㄈㄜㄣ³. |
| English | You should go to bed earlier. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢應該到咗喇。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 jing1 goi1 dou3 zo2 laa3. |
| Yale | kéuih yīng gōi dou jó la. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄧㄥ¹ ㄍㄛㄧ¹ ㄉㄛㄨ³ ㄗㄛ² ㄌㄚ³. |
| English | She should have arrived by now. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我哋應該點做呀？** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 dim2 zou6 aa3? |
| Yale | ngóh deih yīng gōi dím jouh a? |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄉㄝㄧ⁶ ㄧㄥ¹ ㄍㄛㄧ¹ ㄉㄧㆬ² ㄗㄛㄨ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | What should we do? |
